findings: create_nwbfile derives identifier and session_start_time from the recording name, with US/Pacific timezone.
create_subject sets subject_id to nwbfile.identifier, not a separately supplied animal identity.
create_subject reads dc.md for subject_strain; birth date, growth stage, temperature and sex are assigned defaults.
The inspected conversion entry point invokes subject, imaging, segmentation and file-writing functions. This source contains no explicit stimulus-event export.
scope: Pinned public converter source, not proof that every published NWB was generated with this exact code. No NWB dataset or pickle values read. Recording-level identifiers do not establish animal-level independence. Stimulus eligibility remains unverified.
